title: KAIJU NO 8 FULL ANIMATION
author: Admin
content:
Hello everyone!!!

Kaiju no 8 is finally done!! Here is the LINK to the full animation!

¡Y aquí tienen el ENLACE a la animación completa con subtítulos en español!

I'm actually really pleased with how this one turned out! It was an idea I loved from beginning to end, so I've been excited for quite a while to share this one with you guys.

As a reminder, this was the second SHORT animation that we've had planned for quite a while, you guys already saw Sakamoto days, this is the second one.

I honestly wish this one could have been full length, these characters are so fun to work with, and the art style is just so fun and tasty to draw.

Anyway! Up next after this one should be Frieren! (or DxD's sequel...? We shall seee)

Frieren's project in particular is getting a lot of love and attention. It's for sure a labor of passion.

Progress has continued on Maple-chan, Robin x Zoro, and Rukia x Ichigo as well.

If the dropbox link isn't working also, don't worry! It always gets fixed as quickly as possible. You can always join the discord and view all the animations there as well!

Thank you again everyone! Please enjoy, and take it easy this week!

-Maple
